title: Fix broken PWA surface in production: favicon.svg 404s, manifest.json never linked/served on gait.jedarden.com
description:
Verified live against https://gait.jedarden.com on 2026-07-20:
- GET /favicon.svg -> 404 (no such file exists anywhere in the repo;
  index.html references "./favicon.svg" but it was never added).
- GET /manifest.json -> 404, and the served HTML has no
  <link rel="manifest"> tag at all, even though index.html.template
  (used by docker-entrypoint.sh for BASE_PATH substitution) does have one
  ("${BASE_PATH}/manifest.json") — the root index.html that Vite actually
  builds from lacks it, so the two have drifted and production ends up
  with neither.
- public/manifest.json's only icon entry points at public/image.png, an
  unoptimized 829,593-byte PNG for what should be a 512x512 icon.

README claims "PWA Ready: Installable as a Progressive Web App" — this is
not true of the current production deployment (no manifest reachable, no
service worker either).

Fix: add a real favicon.svg, add the manifest <link> to the root
index.html (or reconcile index.html / index.html.template so only one is
the source of truth), and replace image.png with a properly sized/
optimized icon (a few KB to a few hundred KB, not 830KB, for a 512x512
PNG). Confirm by re-fetching /favicon.svg and /manifest.json against the
live URL after deploy.

title: Wire App.tsx to service/analysis architecture so live demo does real gait analysis (ADR-001 component swap-in)

comments.author: cli
comments.text:
Gap source: docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 (2026-07-20), Decision item 1 + Consequences ("split into ... then component swap-in ..."). This is the central, still-uncovered piece of ADR-001. The sibling incremental beads exist (fake-metric removal bf-2t4, debug-component gating bf-6bt, per-frame console.log gating bf-4vd), but no bead tracks the actual re-pointing of the deployed entry point at the existing service/analysis layer.

Evidence (verified 2026-07-29):
- src/App.tsx (the entry point rendered at gait.jedarden.com via src/main.tsx) imports only PoseDetectionService, ControlPanel, PerformanceMonitor, PoseDetectionDiagnostic, SimplePoseTest, CameraSelector. It does NOT import ApplicationCoordinator, GaitAnalysisService, VideoDisplay, PoseOverlay, SkeletonRenderer, or GaitVisualizationSystem.
- The only reference to the service layer in App.tsx is a comment at line 734: coordinator={null} // Would need ApplicationCoordinator in full implementation.
- App.tsx hand-rolls its own getUserMedia + requestAnimationFrame loop and draws skeleton/keypoints inline (processFrame, roughly lines 218-415), duplicating logic that already exists in src/rendering, src/components/SkeletonRenderer.ts, and PoseOverlay.tsx.
- src/services/GaitAnalysisService.ts (real cadence/stride-length/symmetry-index/gait-phase math, exercised by tests/GaitAnalysisService.test.ts and tests/integration) is never called from the shipped page, so the product namesake gait-analysis feature is not delivered to visitors.

Scope (per ADR-001): incremental rewrite of App.tsx internals only. Do NOT rewrite the analysis services (already built + tested) and do NOT touch the external URL, container, or deploy pipeline.

Acceptance criteria:
- App.tsx drives pose capture/detection through the existing service layer (ApplicationCoordinator / GaitPoseDetectionService or PoseDetectionService as coordinated), not a second hand-rolled getUserMedia + rAF loop.
- Skeleton/keypoint rendering goes through SkeletonRenderer/PoseOverlay (or GaitVisualizationSystem) instead of the inline canvas-drawing block in processFrame.
- GaitAnalysisService is wired into the frame loop and its real GaitParameters (cadence, stride length, symmetry index, gait phase) are surfaced in the UI at gait.jedarden.com.
- PerformanceMonitor receives a real coordinator instead of coordinator={null}.
- No behavioral regression to camera selection, start/stop/reset, or export controls.
- Existing service/integration tests still pass; add/extend coverage for the newly-wired path if the swap changes public seams.

Ordering note: complements (does not duplicate) bf-2t4, bf-6bt, bf-4vd. Once this lands the README Gait Analysis / Motion Tracking copy will match the live demo -- ADR-001 says do that docs pass AFTER this integration is real, so it is intentionally left as a follow-on and not filed separately here.

title: Wire Argo Events webhook trigger for pose-detection (eventsource entry + sensor)
description:
Wire push-to-main triggering for pose-detection-build, following the palm-reading pattern in jedarden/declarative-config k8s/iad-ci/argo-events/.

1. Add a pose-detection entry to github-eventsource.yml (EventSource github-webhooks, ns argo-events): owner jedarden, names [pose-detection], webhook endpoint /pose-detection, port 12000, url https://webhooks-ci.ardenone.com, events [push], apiToken+webhookSecret from github-webhook-secret (keys token / webhook-secret), insecure false, active true, contentType json. The controller auto-creates the GitHub webhook on the repo via the apiToken.
2. Create pose-detection-sensor.yml modeled on palm-reading-sensor.yml: Sensor pose-detection-sensor in argo-events ns; dependency eventSourceName github-webhooks / eventName pose-detection; filters: headers.X-Github-Event == push, body.ref == refs/heads/main, plus auto-bump cascade guard (replicate palm filter; the build commits as user jedarden with message prefix ci: auto-bump — prefer a message-based exclusion if comparator supports it, and verify no infinite build loop after first triggered run). Trigger: argoWorkflow submit, generateName pose-detection-build-, workflowTemplateRef pose-detection-build, params git-repo=jedarden/pose-detection branch=main.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Both files committed+pushed; argo-events app on iad-ci syncs
2. kubectl --kubeconfig=/home/coding/.kube/iad-ci.kubeconfig get sensor pose-detection-sensor -n argo-events exists
3. GitHub webhook appears on jedarden/pose-detection (gh api repos/jedarden/pose-detection/hooks)
4. A push to main produces a Workflow run

description:

Steps:

4. Confirm new semver tag on docker.io/ronaldraygun/gait-detection (Docker Hub)
5. Confirm declarative-config commit pinned k8s/apexalgo-iad/gait/gait-detection-deployment.yml to the new semver, ArgoCD app gait-ns-apexalgo-iad Synced+Healthy (curl -sk https://argocd-ro-ardenone-manager-ts.ardenone.com:8444/api/v1/applications/gait-ns-apexalgo-iad), pod in ns gait on apexalgo-iad runs new image (kubectl --server=http://traefik-apexalgo-iad:8001 get pods -n gait)

title: Author Argo WorkflowTemplate pose-detection-build in declarative-config (ronaldraygun/gait-detection image)
description:
Create k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/pose-detection-build-workflowtemplate.yml in jedarden/declarative-config (clone at ~/declarative-config; git pull --rebase before touching, push immediately after commit).

Model on palm-reading-build-workflowtemplate.yml. IMPORTANT naming quirk: the repo is jedarden/pose-detection but the production image/deployment is gait-detection (live site gait.jedarden.com runs ronaldraygun/gait-detection:0.1.3 in namespace gait on apexalgo-iad). Keep template name pose-detection-build (matches repo), image name gait-detection (matches deployment).

Steps: test -> resolve-version -> docker-build (kaniko) -> update-declarative-config.
- test step (replaces the old GH Actions ci.yml test job): node:20-alpine (pin a specific tag/digest, not :latest), clone repo, npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build. activeDeadlineSeconds ~900, resources ~2Gi/1cpu. The old GH matrix tested node 18+20; a single node 20 run is sufficient
- Params: git-repo=jedarden/pose-detection, branch=main
- resolve-version: VERSION file does NOT exist in repo; initialize at 0.1.4 (deployed image is 0.1.3) and commit per palm-reading else-branch pattern. Git identity user.email github@jedarden.com / user.name jedarden; GH_TOKEN from secret github-webhook-secret key token
- kaniko: Dockerfile at repo root, context git://github.com/REPO.git#refs/heads/BRANCH, destinations docker.io/ronaldraygun/gait-detection:VERSION + :latest, --cache=true --cache-repo=ronaldraygun/cache, mount docker-hub-registry secret as /kaniko/.docker exactly like palm-reading. Pin kaniko executor to a version tag (e.g. v1.23.2), not :latest
- update-declarative-config: sed image tag in k8s/apexalgo-iad/gait/gait-detection-deployment.yml (ronaldraygun/gait-detection:0.1.3 -> new semver), commit+push with same git identity

Acceptance criteria:
1. File committed+pushed to declarative-config main
2. kubectl --kubeconfig=/home/coding/.kube/iad-ci.kubeconfig get workflowtemplate pose-detection-build -n argo-workflows succeeds

comments.author: cli
comments.text: HEADS-UP from migration setup (2026-06-10): npm run lint currently FAILS on main — verified by GH Actions run triggered today (Run linter step failed on node 18 and 20; the repo's only previous CI run in July 2025 also failed the same way). Options for the test step: (a) fix the lint errors first in a separate commit, or (b) gate the template's test step on npm test + npm run build only and add lint back once fixed. Do NOT ship a template whose test step is red on day one — that would block every build including the verification bead.

title: Delete stale .backup service files; resolve orphaned GaitDetectionSystem.ts + WasmOptimizer.ts
description:
Two categories of dead/orphaned code found during the 2026-07-20 artifact
review:

1. src/services/PoseDetectionService.ts.backup and
   src/services/PoseSmoothingService.ts.backup are stale duplicates of the
   live .ts files (confirmed via diff — older docstrings, diverged
   content), not imported anywhere. Delete them; git history already
   preserves prior versions.

2. src/GaitDetectionSystem.ts is the only importer of
   src/wasm/WasmOptimizer.ts, and src/GaitDetectionSystem.ts itself is not
   imported from anywhere reachable from src/main.tsx (confirmed via
   repo-wide grep). Both files are unreachable dead code today. Either:
   (a) wire GaitDetectionSystem/WasmOptimizer in as a real WASM-backend
   fallback path (PoseDetectionService.ts currently only falls back
   webgl -> cpu, never wasm, despite this file existing), or
   (b) delete both if WASM support isn't actually wanted.

Acceptance: no .backup files remain under src/, and
GaitDetectionSystem.ts/WasmOptimizer.ts are either reachable from the app
entry point or removed.

title: Remove fabricated metrics from production UI/export (movement intensity, pose/session duration)
description:
src/App.tsx (the actual gait.jedarden.com entry point) ships three fabricated
values to real users as if measured:

- processFrame's movementIntensity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2, shown in the
  UI as "Movement Intensity".
- poseMetrics.poseDuration: (timestamp - (timestamp - 1000)) / 1000 always
  evaluates to 1 (not a real duration).
- handleExport's session.duration: Date.now() - (Date.now() - 60000) always
  equals 60000ms, written into the exported JSON as the session length.

First shippable step toward ADR-001 (docs/plan/plan.md): either compute
these for real (movement intensity from keypoint velocity across frames;
session duration from a real start timestamp captured on handleStart) or
remove the fields from the UI and export payload entirely rather than show
a fake number. This can land before the full service-architecture
integration in ADR-001.

Acceptance: no Math.random() or constant-by-construction value is
presented to the user as a measured metric on gait.jedarden.com.

title: Defer TensorFlow.js/MoveNet model load until user clicks Start
description:
src/App.tsx creates and initializes PoseDetectionService (which loads
TF.js + the MoveNet model, several MB) inside the useEffect that runs on
component mount, before the user has granted camera access or clicked
Start. Every visitor to gait.jedarden.com pays this download/init cost
even if they never start detection.

Move the PoseDetectionService.initialize() call to fire on first Start
click (or on camera-permission grant) instead of on mount, so page load /
time-to-interactive isn't gated on downloading and initializing the ML
model. tensorflow is already its own manualChunk in vite.config.ts, so
this is purely a matter of when the chunk is fetched/awaited, not a
bundling change.

Acceptance: TF.js/model network requests do not fire until the user
initiates detection.

title: Level-gate console.log calls in the per-frame hot path (src/App.tsx processFrame)
description:
src/App.tsx's processFrame runs on every requestAnimationFrame tick
(up to ~60/sec while detection is running) and contains multiple
unconditional console.log calls (e.g. "processFrame called - video:...",
plus several more gated only every 30 frames). This runs against the
README's "Performance Optimized... 60+ FPS" and "Real-time" claims and
adds unnecessary work to the hot path on the live gait.jedarden.com demo.

src/services/LoggingService.ts already exists — route processFrame's
logging through it (or an equivalent level-gated logger) so verbose
per-frame logs no-op by default in production and can be re-enabled for
debugging without editing source.

Acceptance: no unconditional console.log executes on every animation
frame in the production build.

title: Gate debug-only components (PoseDetectionDiagnostic, SimplePoseTest) out of default production render
description:
src/App.tsx renders <PoseDetectionDiagnostic /> and <SimplePoseTest />
unconditionally in the main return, each preceded by a comment reading
"Temporary for debugging". Both ship to every visitor of gait.jedarden.com
today.

Gate them behind import.meta.env.DEV or a ?debug=1 query param so the
public production page doesn't render debug-only UI by default.

Acceptance: gait.jedarden.com no longer shows the diagnostic/test panels
unless explicitly opted into via a debug flag.
